23150.question_text: What must be added to the expression x\(^2\) - 18x to make it a perfect square?
23150.explanation:
x\(^2\) - 18x to be a perfect square.

\((\frac{b}{2})^2\) is added to ax\(^2\) + bx + c in order to make it a perfect square.

\(x^2 - 18x + (\frac{-18}{2})^2\)

= \(x^2 - 18x + 81\)

23152.question_text: The angle of a sector of a circle of radius 8cm is 240°. This sector is bent to form a cone. Find the radius of the base of the cone.
23152.explanation:
L = θ/360 x 2πR = 240/360 x 2 x 22/7 x 8/1 ... (1)

This must be equal to the circumference of the circle which is 2πr = 44R/7 .... (2)

equate (1) and (2)

r = 16/3 = 5\(\frac{1}{3}\)

23153.subject: Mathematics
23153.question_text: The curved surface area of a cylindrical tin is 704cm\(^2\). Calculate the height when the radius is 8cm. [Take π = 22/7]
23153.explanation:
Curved surface area of a cylindrical tin = \(2\pi rh\)

\(\therefore 2\pi rh = 704cm^2\)

\(2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 8 \times h = 704\)

\(h = \frac{704 \times 7}{2 \times 22 \times 8}\)

\(h = 14cm\)

23155.question_text: The area of a parallelogram is 513cm\(^2\) and the height is 19cm. Calculate the base.
23155.explanation:
Area of parallelogram = base \(\times\) height.

\(513 = base \times 19 \implies base = \frac{513}{19}\)

= 27 cm

23156.subject: Mathematics
23156.question_text:
The diagram above shows the shaded segment of a circle of radius 7cm. if the area of the triangle OXY is 12\(\frac{1}{4}\)cm\(^2\), calculate the area of the segment
[Take π = 22/7]
23156.explanation:
Area of \(\Delta OXY\) = \(12\frac{1}{4} cm^2\)

Area of sector OXY = \(\frac{30}{360} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 7 \times 7\)

= \(\frac{77}{6} = 12\frac{5}{6} cm^2\)

Area of the shaded portion = \(12\frac{5}{6} - 12\frac{1}{4}\)

= \(\frac{7}{12} cm^2\)

23168.subject: Mathematics
23168.question_text: If cos θ = 5/13, what is the value of tan \(\theta\) for 0 < θ < 90° ?
23168.explanation:
\(\cos \theta = \frac{5}{13}\)

\(\implies\) In the right- angled triangle, with an angle \(\theta\), the adjacent side to \(\theta\) = 5 and the hypotenuse = 13.

\(\therefore 13^2 = opp^2 + 5^2\)

\(opp^2 = 169 - 25 = 144 \implies opp = \sqrt{144}\)

= 12.

\(\tan \theta = \frac{opp}{adj} = \frac{12}{5}\)

A ladder leans against a vertical wall at an angle

away from the wall, calculate the length of the
ladder.
23172.explanation:
The ladder makes 60° inclination with the wall and its foot is 5m away from the wall.

Sketching the diagram, you will see that we have

\(sin 60 = \frac{5}{x}\) (where x is the length of the ladder)

⇒ \(x = \frac{5}{sin60}\)

\(x = \frac{10\sqrt{3}}{3}m\)

23182.subject: Mathematics
23182.question_text: What is the probability of throwing a number greater than 2 with a single fair die
23182.explanation:
If a die is rolled once, the probability of getting a number greater than 2 is \(\frac{2}{3}\).

i.e Pr( number greater than 2) = \(\frac{\text{ no of required outcome}}{\text{total no of expected outcome}}\)

= \(\frac{4}{6} = \frac{2}{3}\)
